title: 2535. Difference Between Element Sum and Digit Sum of an Array

examples.explanation: The element sum of nums is 1 + 15 + 6 + 3 = 25. The digit sum of nums is 1 + 1 + 5 + 6 + 3 = 16. The absolute difference between the element sum and digit sum is |25 - 16| = 9.
The element sum of nums is 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10. The digit sum of nums is 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10. The absolute difference between the element sum and digit sum is |10 - 10| = 0.
